text:
The purity of the eightfold noble path,
the purity of form,
and the purity of omniscience are not two, cannot be divided into two, are not broken apart, and are not multiple.
The purity of the eightfold noble path
is the purity of feeling.
The purity of feeling
is the purity of omniscience.
Thus, the purity of the eightfold noble path, the purity of feeling,
